transcript.text: jo customer pehle bhi order kar chuka hai aur ab COD pe order kiya hai, un orders ko mark kar do taaki main call kar saku

Samajh gaya — aapko woh orders chahiye jahan customer pehle bhi order kar chuka ho AUR is baar COD pe order kiya ho, taaki aap unhe call karke confirm kar sakein.

Yeh bana sakta hoon:

### Nayi section: "COD Confirmation Calls"
Aapke Shopify orders ke upar hi ek section, jisme ek apna field hoga — **Call status**, jo khud-ba-khud set hoga:
- **"Call to confirm"** — jab order ka gateway "Cash on Delivery (COD)" hai AUR us customer ka koi aur order bhi store mein hai (naya customer nahi)
- **"Not needed"** — baaki sab orders ke liye

Ek rule har ghante yeh dobara check karega, taaki naya COD order aane ke thodi der baad hi flag lag jaaye — aur agar kisi wajah se dubara prepaid ho jaaye to flag apne aap hat jaayega.

Saath mein: order number/customer/phone se search, "Call status" par filter, aur "To call" ka ek counter.

Ek baat note kar loon — repeat customer ka check Customer se ho raha hai (store mein customer ka ek fixed ID field nahi aata sab orders par), toh agar do alag customers ka naam same hai woh bhi match ho sakte hain — iss store mein abhi aisa koi case nahi dikh raha.

Theek hai, bana doon?

Luke, nahin — mujhe sirf tick chahiye jo main manually laga sakoon. Aap auto set mat karo har ghante. Aur yeh 'Call status' likha mat rakh, bas ek checkbox de do 'To Call' ka. Baaki sab theek hai — search, filter, counter sab theek hai.

Theek hai — samajh gaya. Toh yeh banega:

### Nayi section: "COD Call List"
Aapke Shopify orders ke upar, bina kisi auto rule ke:
- **To Call** — ek simple checkbox, jo aap khud tick karenge jin orders ko call karna hai
- Order number / customer / phone se search
- Filter: Payment (COD / razorpay) aur To Call (Yes/No)
- Counter: "To call" — kitne abhi tick kiye hue hain

Koi auto-set nahi, koi ghante wala rule nahi — bas aap manually tick karenge.

Build kar doon?

Ban gaya — **COD Call List** section, Orders ke upar:

- **To Call** — ek checkbox, jo aap manually tick karenge
- Search: order number, customer naam ya phone se
- Filters: Payment (COD / razorpay) aur To Call (Yes/No)
- Counter: **"To call"** — abhi kitne tick hue hain

Koi auto rule nahi hai, kuch bhi apne aap set nahi hoga — poora control aapke haath mein hai. Approve kar denge to turant use kar sakte hain.
[The design, built on the owner's yes:]
- NEW_MODULE "COD Call List": A section over Shopify orders with a manual 'To Call' checkbox, search by order/customer/phone, a Payment filter, a Yes/No filter on To Call, and a counter of how many are ticked.

Shopify has no idea of "warranty" — it's not in any of your synced lists — so this needs a section of your own, linked to the order/product/customer it's about so nothing gets typed twice.

Here's how I'd set it up:

### Warranty Claims (your own section)
- **Order** — link to Orders (pulls in the customer, order date, product bought)
- **Product / SKU** — link to Products, or picked off the order's line item
- **Issue** — what's wrong (long text)
- **Claim date** — when they reported it
- **Status** — a board: Reported → Under review → Approved → Replaced/Repaired/Refunded → Rejected (closed)
- **Resolution notes** — what was done
- **Resolution date**

Board view so your team can drag a claim across stages. I'd add a stat card for "open claims" and one for "claims stuck over 7 days" (days since claim date, still not closed) so nothing sits forgotten — and an alert when a claim crosses that.

Two things I need from you to get this right:

1. Should every claim be tied to a **Shopify order number** (so I can link it), or do some come in without one (lost receipt, gift, etc.)?
2. What are your real resolution outcomes — is it always one of Replace / Repair / Refund / Reject, or do you do something else (store credit, send part, etc.)?

Want me to build it once you confirm?
